runs.estimator: shipped estimator + regime layer PR1 (WO-075/0.9.48) — Onyxia air-phase confCap
runs.corpus: Fresh Onyxia ×200 (id 151084). Regime = per-health-bin confCap over the air-phase bins (8-12).
runs.label: Onyxia regime (PR1)

compare.highlights: Onyxia regime (WO-075 PR1): a per-bin confCap makes the bar go QUIET through the unreadable air phase → MAPE mean 57%→44%, median 55%→43%, reads-long bias +41s→+20s, shown 99%→55%.
compare.method: A stall-gated FREEZE was tried first and found WRONG for Onyxia: 200 kills show the air phase is a SLOWDOWN (ranged chips health), not a true stall, so the freeze over-holds and grows a heavy right tail (mean 63-83%). The honest fix is the confCap (bar quiet where unreadable). The freeze mechanism ships for TRUE-stall bosses (Viscidus/Ouro, later PRs). An adversarial 6-lens verify also caught + fixed a cadence-dependent freeze gate.

runs.estimator: shipped estimator + regime layer PR2 (WO-075/0.9.48) — learned confCap roster + suppressFlush
runs.corpus: 10 structural bosses x60 Fresh kills + Onyxia x200 (800 fixtures). Caps LEARNED from the estimator's own measured per-bin error (tools/estimator-perbin.lua); graded on the HELD-OUT odd half against the SHIPPED profiles.
runs.corpus_short: 10 bosses x60 + Onyxia x200 · regime PR2
runs.label: regime roster (PR2)
runs.note: Per-boss held-out results below; there is no single aggregate because each boss is its own regime.

buru.why: suppressFlush — scripted egg-phase cliffs were flushing a sound prior

rajaxx.why: wave gate — the whole opening is unreadable

twin_emperors.why: two pools behind one readout — health is uninformative all fight; the bar stays quiet

chromaggus.why: measured as readable — correctly NO caps

ouro.why: measured as readable — correctly NO caps

jindo.why: caps learned but all above the show threshold — no behavioural change

findings: confCap is learned from the estimator's OWN measured per-bin error, not a statistical proxy: the obvious proxy (dispersion of remaining time) explodes as the denominator vanishes and would have silenced the ENDGAME — the stretch the readout gets most right (~3s error with 10s to live).
Caps use two currencies: <=30% relative OR <=5s absolute is useful (keeps the endgame); >=45s absolute is never usable (kills the pull); between, the cap crosses the 0.5 show threshold at 50% error.
The universal default cap must NOT be folded into a MEASURED boss — doing so silenced Chromaggus' most readable band and made his grade worse. It remains the fallback for un-profiled bosses only.
The FREEZE tier is subsumed by confCap: on this roster no freeze band improved a grade, and freeze-only made Viscidus worse (85.5%->90.5%). No shipped profile uses one.
Categorical facts must be active while measuring: Buru's caps learned without suppressFlush were calibrated to an estimator ~3x worse and over-silenced a usable readout.

runs.estimator: shipped estimator + regime layer PR3 (WO-075/0.9.48) — Thekal resetOnRise; freeze tier REMOVED
runs.corpus: Thekal x60 + Gahz'ranka x60 added (920 fixtures total). Graded held-out against the SHIPPED profiles.
runs.label: Thekal + freeze removal (PR3)

thekal.why: three priests behind one health readout: 55-100% measured error in EVERY bin, so the bar stays quiet. resetOnRise (30/30 kills resurrect) improves the underlying estimate 124.9%->84.9% but is not yet enough to make it showable.

gahzranka.why: the NEGATIVE CONTROL for the id discipline — 0/60 kills show a rise, and he correctly gets no resetOnRise

findings: The id fact is verified against real data, not assumed: WCL fixture names give 150789 = 'High Priest Thekal' and 150790 = "Gahz'ranka". Thekal resurrects in 60/60 kills (largest rise 100%); Gahz'ranka in 0/60. A spec asserts the reset is keyed on 789 and absent on 790 in BOTH id spaces.

The FREEZE tier was REMOVED (D-020): no shipped profile used it, it never improved a grade, freeze-only made Viscidus worse (85.5%->90.5%), and it duplicated the driver's first-class sample(t,h,damageable=false). Three real defects had already been found in it by verification — in code nothing invoked.

The learner now determines curve/categorical facts BEFORE measuring and feeds them back as a context regime, so derived caps are always calibrated against the estimator that actually ships (Thekal ~1.5x, Buru ~3x better with their own facts active). The context never includes confCap, which would make the derivation circular.
The assembler now hard-fails on a generated comment line >120 chars: StyLua rewraps code but not comments, so a long note would silently break the lint gate on a file nobody hand-edits.
